title: formula: provide fallback git identity in sandbox
body:

Used Claude Code (Claude Fable 5.1) to help understand the source of the problem and draft the code. Reviewed manually.

-----

Sandboxed `brew test` nulls `GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL`, so a test that runs `git commit` without configuring `user.name` and `user.email` relies on git auto-detecting an identity from the hostname. With `deny_network_access!` that hostname lookup is blocked, so git fails with "unable to auto-detect email address" on any machine whose hostname needs DNS to resolve. For example, `brew test sem-cli` fails locally. I [attempted a fix for `sem-cli`](https://github.com/Homebrew/homebrew-core/pull/312732), but realized the root cause was the sandbox.

CI never spotted this because [`brew test-bot` exports `HOMEBREW_GIT_NAME` and `HOMEBREW_GIT_EMAIL` before running any test](https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/blob/1d86792829d8f5986edb6272fc5b36a38d055f5c/Library/Homebrew/test_bot.rb#L159-L161).

This PR changes the sandbox by adding `.gitconfig` with a fallback `user.name` and `user.email` in their isolated `HOME`, and `GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL` points at that file instead of `/dev/null`.
